name: The Resort
source:
The Resort is a visual novel set on an island resort located on a tropical island known as Edilide Island. 

You're Nathan, a goat who has just finished their semester at college when you and your childhood best friend Anthony receive invites for a free month long stay at The Celestial Court alongside several other characters. The owner, Hans, welcomes you & the others but reveals the truth that he needs help in getting folks to help work the place to raise enough money to save the place by the end of the month lest he'll be forced to close the place of business for good.

During your time at the resort, you'll learn about the other characters working alongside you as you navigate the resort and the island itself encountering strange things & beings as several things & events threaten the future of the resort and the island itself.

[From [url=https://ryuknight88.itch.io/the-resort]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《度假村》是一部视觉小说，以位于热带岛屿艾迪利德岛的岛屿度假村为背景。

你是内森，一只刚刚完成大学学期的山羊，你和你儿时最好的朋友安东尼收到邀请，与其他几个角色一起在天庭免费住宿一个月。店主汉斯欢迎你和其他人，但透露了真相，他需要帮助让人们帮助工作，以筹集足够的资金在月底之前拯救这个地方，以免他将被迫永久关闭营业场所。

在度假村期间，你将了解与你一起工作的其他角色，因为你在度假村和岛屿本身中航行时会遇到奇怪的事物和生物，因为有几件事和事件威胁着度假村和岛屿本身的未来。

[来自[url=https://ryuknight88.itch.io/the-resort]Itch.io[/url]]
